paper.title: Accurate Self-Attention Wavefunctions at Large Scale
paper.authors: Filippo Gaggioli, Sam Azadi, Liang Fu

results.system_description: 2D homogeneous electron gas, N = 91 (91 up, 0 down), r_s = 30, 60-degree rhombic (triangular-lattice) cell, Gamma point
results.variant: NN-VMC: self-attention with spatially weighted particle attention (~800K params)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational Monte Carlo energy of the neural-network wave function (NN-VMC: self-attention with spatially weighted particle attention (~800K params)) at this N, r_s and cell, without finite-size correction or twist averaging.
results.notes: As printed (energy per electron, in Hartree). Madelung term: Ewald following CASINO manual (Madelung presumably included; not stated separately). Boundary: periodic, Gamma point (explicit; DMC references also at Gamma, no TABC).
